The square is quiet at this hour, and there are two people in it who are not talking to each other.
Somebody has been at the ground by the wall. The square is quieter than it was, and stays quieter.
Up close they look like somebody who has been waiting a while and would rather you did not say so.
The hasp is rusted through. It would open for anybody who cared to try.
Fresh earth, and not much of it. Whoever dug this was in a hurry.
A boat is pulled up the bank with nothing in it and nobody near it.
The road goes under at the ford, and somebody is standing on the far side of it.
